Set private

Abandoned

Platform init removed from openbmc
We absolutely do not allow compiled code in openbmc/openbmc.
milliseconds resolution for any utility using gpio please.  Seconds can be automagically converted to milliseconds.

...... <ed gets on soapbox>

These kinds of comments are a waste and don't add value

bus -> the i2c bus number

the variable could be called bus_number and no need for the comment.

Lets write clear code, and add comments where things are non obvious.

nit, order should go buffer then size.

But also ideally we should be using

std::span<uint8_t> buffer;

So we explicitly include a buffer.

Lets not reinvent what exists:
https://manpages.debian.org/unstable/i2c-tools/libi2c.3.en.html

If you need me to make you an example, I'm happy to.
if you intended to remove this prior to merge, please do.
Don't combine conditions like this.  As written, if you see the log, you have no idea if it was vr1 or vr2 that failed.
nit, "Force"
You can't assert FPGA_RST_L-O before you start watching for FPGA_READY_BMC-I.  If FPGA_READY_BMC-I asserts first, you might miss it.
Nit, remove "set"
please use colons as a delimiter.
I don't see any mention of this in the commit message?  Seems unrelated to UT3.0B
